lede.zh: 本报告给出 Qwen3-32B BF16 在昇腾 910B4 上的真实 ShareGPT 服务矩阵，涵盖三种推理引擎、五档并发、吞吐与延迟。
lede.en: This report measures Qwen3-32B BF16 on Ascend 910B4 with real ShareGPT traffic across three serving engines and five concurrency levels.

snapshot.zh: 3 个引擎 · 5 档并发 · 45 个三轮中位点 · 0% 错误
snapshot.en: 3 engines · 5 concurrency points · 45 three-run medians · 0% errors

stats.zhNote: 多轮 · 输出上限 512 tokens

heading.zh: 单一权重的多引擎服务实测
heading.en: Serving measurements for one checkpoint across engines

intro.zh: 同一 Qwen3-32B BF16 权重与 ShareGPT 负载，分别测量 vLLM-Ascend、MindIE 和 SGLang。这里比较引擎表现，不比较不同权重。
intro.en: The same Qwen3-32B BF16 checkpoint and ShareGPT workload were measured on vLLM-Ascend, MindIE, and SGLang. This compares serving engines, not different checkpoints.

note.zh: 吞吐随并发增长，但 TTFT/ITL 长尾会改变服务体验。结果是三轮中位，适用于本页列出的 910B4、TP4 和请求分布。
note.en: Throughput grows with concurrency, while TTFT/ITL tails affect serving experience. Values are three-run medians for the stated 910B4 setup, TP4 layout, and request mix.

heading.zh: 并发增加整体吞吐，同时扩大 TTFT 与 ITL 尾部
heading.en: Higher concurrency increases aggregate throughput and widens TTFT / ITL tails

intro.zh: Qwen3-32B BF16，8×Ascend 910B4；每引擎 TP4。ShareGPT English，多轮流量，thinking 关闭、max output 512、prefix cache 开启；5 档并发，每档 3 次取中位数。
intro.en: Qwen3-32B BF16 on eight Ascend 910B4 accelerators; TP4 per engine. ShareGPT English multi-turn traffic, thinking disabled, max output 512, prefix caching enabled; five concurrency points with three runs summarized by median.

notes.zh: 三引擎 45 个测试组合的错误率均为 0%。客户端 TTFT/ITL 口径一致；KV/cache 与调度队列指标因引擎归一化口径不一致，不用于跨引擎对比。
notes.en: All 45 engine/concurrency combinations reported 0% errors. Client TTFT/ITL definitions are aligned; engine KV/cache and scheduler-wait metrics use non-equivalent normalization and are excluded from cross-engine comparison.

notes.zh: C128 时 vLLM 与 SGLang 的吞吐/延迟行为变化明显，属于本次 ShareGPT 配置的观察，不代表其他对话长度。
notes.en: At C128, vLLM and SGLang show marked throughput/latency changes. This is specific to this ShareGPT setup and does not generalize to other conversation lengths.

heading.zh: 吞吐之外，应同时看 TTFT、ITL 与排队时间
heading.en: Throughput should be read alongside TTFT, ITL, and queue time

intro.zh: 三项客户端延迟均来自 evalscope，同一负载集与并发档；各引擎执行时单独调度实例以避免显存争抢。
intro.en: Client latency metrics come from evalscope using the same dataset and concurrency points; engines were scheduled individually to avoid memory contention.

notes.zh: SGLang C128 输出速率低于 C64；该点保持 0% 错误，但 P95 TTFT 与 ITL 显著升高。MindIE C128 TTFT P95 也出现较大长尾。
notes.en: SGLang C128 output rate is below C64; the point has 0% errors but substantially higher P95 TTFT and ITL. MindIE C128 also shows a pronounced TTFT P95 tail.

rows: 同一 ShareGPT 测试口径 / same workload

body.zh: 每个配置 3 次重复，归纳值为中位数；远程链路曾发生的失败重跑后均为 0 错误。公开报告不包含集群内部监控地址或机器标识。
body.en: Each configuration has three runs summarized by median; after reruns for remote-link failures, all reported errors are zero. Internal monitoring endpoints and machine identifiers are omitted.

methodIntro.zh: ModelDoctor 调度客户端执行 evalscope perf；每个引擎同一时间只部署一份，非目标实例缩容以避免显存竞争。
methodIntro.en: ModelDoctor scheduled evalscope perf clients; only one target engine instance ran at a time to avoid memory contention.

meta.value: ShareGPT English · max output 512 · thinking off

methodNotes.zh: prefix cache 各引擎的监控计数归一化不一致，未列入跨引擎结论。KV cache 与 scheduler wait 也不作引擎间直接比较。
methodNotes.en: Prefix-cache counters are not consistently normalized across engines and are excluded from cross-engine conclusions. KV-cache and scheduler-wait metrics are also not compared directly.

methodNotes.zh: 无主机名、地址、监控端点、原始 prompt 或实验路径。
methodNotes.en: Hostnames, addresses, monitoring endpoints, raw prompts, and source paths are omitted.
